segments.text: When I moved to Manchester, I couldn't believe how often it rained.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker expresses surprise at the frequent rain after moving to Manchester.
segments.turkishExplanation: Manchester'a taşındığımda bu kadar sık yağmur yağdığına inanamamıştım.

segments.text: Back home, I used to check the sky before going out.
segments.englishExplanation: In their hometown, the speaker used to check the weather before leaving home.
segments.turkishExplanation: Memleketimde dışarı çıkmadan önce gökyüzüne bakardım.

segments.englishExplanation: In Manchester, people do not bother checking the weather before going out.

segments.text: People are used to grey mornings, and they simply carry on with their plans.
segments.englishExplanation: Local people are accustomed to cloudy mornings and continue their plans anyway.
segments.turkishExplanation: İnsanlar gri sabahlara alışkın ve planlarına aynen devam ediyorlar.

segments.text: For the first few months, I just put up with it and complained a lot.
segments.englishExplanation: Initially, the speaker tolerated the constant rain while complaining frequently.
segments.turkishExplanation: İlk birkaç ay boyunca sadece buna katlandım ve çokça şikayet ettim.

segments.englishExplanation: Then the speaker's mindset or perspective changed.

segments.text: I bought proper boots, started walking anyway,
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker bought appropriate footwear and continued walking outside despite the weather.
segments.turkishExplanation: Uygun çizmeler aldım ve yine de yürümeye başladım,

segments.text: and slowly got used to the sound of rain on the window.
segments.englishExplanation: Over time, the speaker became accustomed to hearing rain against the windowpane.
segments.turkishExplanation: ve zamanla penceredeki yağmur sesine alıştım.

segments.text: Now I actually miss it when I travel.
segments.englishExplanation: Currently, the speaker misses the Manchester weather when traveling elsewhere.
segments.turkishExplanation: Şimdilerde seyahat ettiğimde aslında onu özlüyorum.

segments.text: Funny how a place you once tolerated can plightly become home.
segments.englishExplanation: It is surprising how a place that was once just tolerated can gradually feel like home.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bir zamanlar katlandığınız bir yerin zamanla yuvanız haline gelmesi ne garip.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To continue an activity or task, especially despite difficult circumstances.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Özellikle zorluklara rağmen bir faaliyete veya plana devam etmek.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Despite the heavy rain, they decided to carry on with their match.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Şiddetli yağmura rağmen maça devam etmeye karar verdiler.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To tolerate or accept a difficult or annoying situation without complaining.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Zor veya rahatsız edici bir duruma sineye çekerek katlanmak.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I cannot put up with this noise any longer.

quiz.question: In segment 5, what does the phrasal verb 'put up with' mean in this context?

options.text: To accept or tolerate an unpleasant condition
To completely stop doing a daily routine
To change one's plans because of the weather
To enjoy a new experience enthusiastically
